items.body_raw: עֵינַי עַל־כָּל־דַּרְכֵיהֶם לֹא נִסְתְּרוּ מִלְּפָנָי וְלֹא־נִצְפַּן עֲוֹנָם מִנֶּגֶד עֵינָי
items.answer_raw: Mine eyes are upon all their ways, they are not hidden from my face; neither is their iniquity concealed from mine eyes.

items.body_raw: לֹא תְמוּתוּן כִּי יֹדֵעַ אֱלֹהִים כִּי בְּיוֹם אֲכָלְכֶם מִן־הָעֵץ וְנִפְקְחוּ עֵינֵיכֶם
items.answer_raw: Ye shall not die, for God knoweth that in the day that ye eat of the tree, your eyes shall be opened.
Your vineyards and olive-trees the locusts repeatedly devoured.
The wealth of the nations shall come unto thee.
Ye have delivered our lives from death.
I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth.

items.body_raw: וישמעו את־קול יהוה מתהלך בתוך עץ הגן לרוח היום ויתחבא האדם ואשתו מפניו
items.answer_raw: And they heard the voice of Yahweh as he walked in the midst of the trees of the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from his presence.

items.body_raw: ולמדתם את־דברי את־בניכם לדבר בם בשבתך בביתך ובלכתך בדרך ובשכבך ובקומך
items.answer_raw: And ye shall teach my words to your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

items.body_raw: Behold I am old, I know not the day of my death.
items.answer_raw: הִנֵּה זָקַנְתִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֶת־יוֹם מוֹתִי

items.body_raw: In those days there-was-not a king in Israel, (every) man did the (thing) upright in his (own) eyes.
items.answer_raw: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה

items.body_raw: And Noah awoke from his wine and knew what his younger (little) son had done to him.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּיקַץ נֹחַ מִיֵּינוֹ וַיֵּדַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לוֹ בְּנוֹ הַקָּטָן

items.body_raw: And the prophet said unto her, And thou (fem.) arise, go to thy house; when thy feet come to-the-city, then (waw cons.) the boy shall die.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הַנָּבִיא וְאַתְּ קוּמִי לְכִי לְבֵיתֵךְ בְּבֹא רַגְלַיִךְ הָעִירָה וּמֵת הַיָּלֶד

items.body_raw: And he offered the ram of the burnt-offering.
And the men feared to return to their houses.
